units.zh: 少襲父爵，官至散騎侍郎，卒諡曰簡。
瓚字國寶，中書郎，風神高邁，見者皆敬之。
特為王綏所重，每從其遊。
綏父戎謂之曰：「國寶初不來，汝數往，何也？」
對曰：「國寶雖不知綏，綏自知國寶。」

assessment: The paragraph explicitly says Wang Sui valued Pei Zan and Sui’s father Rong spoke to him. It supplies neither a surname for 戎 in that sentence nor a tutor/Anfeng/司徒 bridge. The separate comparative list cites 王戎. These are not demonstrably inconsistent solely from this bounded source context; possible-same-as preserves the missing bridge.
